source_only_sampling.rule: From Standard PGN headers select smallest SHA-256(GameURL) per Event, then lowest 24 among distinct events, before reading any move text, Result, %eval, time management annotations or native source outcomes

chess_law_validation.program: Custom independent Go legal chess generator + SAN-to-legal-move disambiguation
tests: reject false checkmate, false check, illegal SAN

actual_game_source_only_geometry.meaning: Counts are raw legal played-move-induced potential ray/defender geometry and elementary strategic board-state proxy differences, not forced tactical wins, strategic plan values or causal SF16 operator response.

TWIC_overlap_source_only.limit: No shared 30-ply prefix or full sequence is not complete FEN/source-history independence or all-corpus verified legal state.

limitations: Source-only game selection is frozen before any SAN legality or motif opportunity detection; no result/eval-based cohort selection
All PGN histories are private, public receipt contains only GameURL SHA, source SHA and summary counters
Custom Go chess rules passed four published perft positions in predecessor P1, but independent third-party legality oracle for all 2038 played plies not yet run
Skewer rays/defender removal are geometry and pseudo-defender counts, not demonstrated favorable tactic under all legal replies
Strategy counts are position proxies, not historical plans, strategic utility or long-horizon stable causal effects
Native source operator intervention on these Lichess games has not yet been executed; no multi-motif operator causal success claim
